messages:
riley: Quick q — how do we want to expose error classes to clients for routing vs console? e.g., should we surface `quota_exceeded` as a stable client code or stick to HTTP `429` only? We need consistency across SDKs, routing policies, and the console badges.

mike: My vote: keep the HTTP semantics (`429`, `503`, etc.) but add a stable machine-readable header `X-Redwood-Error` with namespaced error codes (e.g. `quota.exceeded`, `routing.fallback`, `model.unavailable`). SDKs can map that to typed exceptions. Also add `X-Redwood-Retryable: true|false`.

angela: Product agrees on the header idea. For the console, map those namespaces to human categories (Quota, Capacity, Model). We should show an explainer tooltip and a CTA when it's quota: "Upgrade / Request increase". Badging should be consistent across per-route and per-model dashboards.

sasha: DevEx note — SDKs already parse `Retry-After`. If we emit `X-Redwood-Error` we should also standardize a telemetry tag `error.class` so logs/alerts can group. e.g., `error.class=quota.exceeded` and `error.retryable=true`. This avoids brittle string parsing in downstream analytics.

mike: Implementation sketch (canary first):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Redwood-Error: quota.exceeded
X-Redwood-Retryable: true
Retry-After: 30
```
We will add server-side mapping: internal routing reasons -> error namespace. Router will prefer sending `routing.fallback` when it served from a lower tier.

angela: UX question — do we show raw codes to customers in the console? I prefer friendly phrasing with a toggled advanced view for raw headers. So storefront shows "Quota limit hit" + link; advanced shows `quota.exceeded`.

riley: Good. Also need to consider rate-limiting quanta vs token-usage quota. Should we have subcodes like `quota.rate_limit` vs `quota.monthly_limit`? That'd help in the billing dashboard.

mike: Yes split them. Use dotted namespaces: `quota.rate_limit`, `quota.monthly_limit`, `quota.per_route`. Keep the header short though. Telemetry will carry the more specific `error.class_detail`.

sasha: Telemetry names proposal: `requests.error.count` with tags `error.class`, `error.retryable`, `route`, `model_id`, `customer_tier`. Make sure console can pivot on `error.class`.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolling canary for "error-header-props" started in us-west-2 (tag: canary-errhdr).

mike: Rollout plan: 1) Canary emit headers + telemetry (2% traffic), 2) SDK bump to read headers and expose typed errors, 3) Console mapping & badge rollout, 4) Deprecation notice (if we ever remove any older header formats).

angela: Add docs page with examples and copy snippets for customer-facing messaging. We need recommended strings for messages so console and docs match. e.g., "Quota limit hit — limit per minute exceeded" vs just "Rate limit".

riley: Action items:
- mike: spec header + mapping table (due EOD Wed)
- sasha: telemetry spec + metric names (due Thu)
- angela: console copy + badge designs (due next Mon)
- riley: coordinate SDK PRs and canary window

mike: I'll put up the RFC & PR. tagging @sasha @angela for review. :thumbsup:
